name: calendar
summary: A month grid you can walk with the keys; the component answers the dates, the markup draws them.

data-selected.doc: The day chosen at the start, and the month shown.

data-min.doc: The earliest day that can be chosen.

data-max.doc: The latest day that can be chosen.

data-week-start.doc: The first day of the week, 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday; Monday by default.

data-iso.doc: The day the cell stands for; the keys move from it.

day.doc: One per cell of the grid.

selected.doc: The chosen day; empty for none.

title.doc: The month and year shown, in the page's language.

weekdays.doc: The short day names, from the week's first day.

weeks.type: { iso, day, inMonth, today, disabled, label }[][]
weeks.doc: Whole weeks of cells, from the week holding the 1st to the week holding the last day.

formatted.doc: The chosen day written out in full; empty for none.

select.doc: Chooses a day inside the range.
